# FaceLook / 페이스루크 (lukemodel.com)

> Same-person AI faces and video in the browser — Bring Your Own Keys (BYOK).

## Product
FaceLook is a static GitHub Pages SPA for managing face models (image + video) under one identity. Upload or generate a face once, then keep further images/videos attached to that model. Share via local share codes.

## Honest facts
- Browser-local only: localStorage + IndexedDB. No lukemodel cloud sync yet.
- API keys (Fal, Replicate, OpenAI, Google AI, Higgsfield, etc.) stay in the browser; they are never sent to lukemodel servers (there is no app backend).
- Generation calls go from the user's browser to the provider the user chose.
- Share codes are local packs on the same browser/device — not a multi-user cloud CDN.
- Synthetic / consented faces only. Do not use non-consensual real-person likenesses.
